Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:42483
Court No. - 12

Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 1267 of 2024
Applicant :- Mo. Shoyab

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil Sectt. Lko And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Pradeep Kumar Yadav,Vijay Pal Verma
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Om Prakash Shukla,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. This anticipatory bail application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant
seeking anticipatory bail apprehending arrest in F.I.R. No.180 of 2020 under Sections 498A, 304B
of Ipc and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, Police Station Chhapiya, District Gonda.
3.  As per FIR, which has been lodged by the father of the deceased, the deceased was married with the applicant on 19.04.2018 and out of wedlock, a male child was born.

Since the date of marriage,
her husband always tortured his daughter and always demanded the dowry like Cooler, Fridge etc.

It has also been alleged by the complainant/father of the deceased that mother-in-law, sister-in-law and brother-in-law of his daughter were harassing and tortured his daughter and they also assaulted her.
On 12.05.2020, at 07:00 p.m., one Sabban Ali, who is his neighbour, informed that his daughter committed suicide.
It has also been alleged that husband (applicant herein) and father-in-law of his Mo. Shoyab vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ...
on 4 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142908181/

1 daughter went to Saudi Arabia and both of them have also not transmitted any money to his daughter for her maintenance, on account of which this incident had happened.
4. Submission made by the learned counsel for the applicant is that the applicant is the husband of the deceased and he is not named in the F.I.R.
Applicant has falsely been implicated in the F.I.R.
According to the learned Counsel, the doctor had ascertained that the cause of death of the deceased was due to ante-mortem hanging.

He submits that when the deceased committed suicide, the applicant was not in India, but he was in Saudi Arbia, therefore, the applicant was not involved in any manner in the offence as alleged against him.
According to the learned Counsel, the daughter of the complainant was not mentally fit and she was suffering from mental problems, on account of which she committed suicide.
Applicant has no criminal history.
He has apprehension of imminent arrest.
If released on bail he would not misuse the liberty and would co-operate with the investigation.

5. Learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the prayer and has pointed out that the deceased died in her matrimonial home within seven years of marriage, therefore, it cannot be ruled out the involvment of the applicant in committing the suicide by her wife.
He informs that charge-sheet against the accused persons have been filed before the trial Court and the trial Court took cognizance of the same.

6. Looking to the fact that the deceased died unnatural death in matrimonial home within seven years of marriage and also taking into consideration the gravity of accusation, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court does not find good ground for enlarging the applicant, Mo. Shoyab, on anticipatory bail in this case.
7. The anticipatory bail application of the applicant is , accordingly, rejected.
( Om Prakash Shukla, J.) Order Date :- 4.6.2024
Ajit  Mo. Shoyab vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ...
